in_sanskrit.name: बाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is young, small or boyish. In Hindu mythology, Bala refers to Lord Vishnu in his infant form. This name is also used for boys born in the auspicious Hindu month of Baishakha (April-May).

in_hindi.name: बाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: A young child or boy. In Hindi, the name Bala can also be used for girls as Bala or Balika, meaning young girl or girlish.

in_tamil.name: பால
in_tamil.long_meaning: A boy or a child. In Tamil, the name Bala can also refer to a young man or a leader.

in_telugu.name: బాళ
in_telugu.long_meaning: A child or boy. In Telugu, the name Bala can also refer to Lord Vishnu or Lord Shiva.

in_marathi.name: Bala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Child, Young One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bala originates from the Sanskrit language and means 'Child' or 'Young One'. In Hindu mythology, Bala is a name given to various gods and goddesses, including Lord Ganesha and Goddess Parvati. It is a name of reverence and respect, symbolizing innocence, purity, and the beginning of a new life.
